source_policy.fallback_rule: GitHub/yfinance, FinMind and TAIFEX may fill null fields only when the observation belongs to the same specified trade date/session date. Never silently overwrite a non-null canonical value or use a different trade date.
source_policy.trade_date_rule: Sunday report: U.S. cash markets are closed; latest completed U.S. session remains Friday 2026-08-28. Taiwan cash/FX/OI use 2026-08-28. TAIFEX after-hours physical window 2026-08-28 15:00–2026-08-29 05:00 is attributed to the following regular session; preserve physical window and do not substitute older night data.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: When exact same-session data are not independently verified, retain null or flag validation_required. Different-date values must never be blended or silently overwritten.

SOX.source: same-date canonical; GitHub same-date cross-check required

USD/TWD.source: Taipei FX close; prior official-range cross-check

taiwan_futures.source: Friday-night after-hours quote + 2026-08-28 institutional position table; TAIFEX attribution rule
taiwan_futures.note: Weekend: no newer TX session exists. Preserve the physical Friday-night window and next-session attribution.

finviz.rule: Capture fresh at render time; warn on trade-date mismatch.

sector_rotation.rule: Require 2026-08-28 U.S. trade date; do not reuse older sector output.

taiwan_rotation.rule: Use latest completed 2026-08-28 Taiwan cash session for local price confirmation; flow fields must remain explicit if unavailable.

breaking_news.headline: Bessent warns disorderly yen moves could destabilize global markets
breaking_news.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said sharp yen moves can force unwinds of global positions and raise borrowing costs, keeping FX intervention risk in focus after recent U.S.-Japan action.
breaking_news.market_impact: Adds a weekend macro risk channel through FX, rates and leveraged carry trades.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: A renewed yen shock can spill into Asian FX and foreign-flow volatility even before U.S. cash trading resumes.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. equity funds post biggest weekly outflow since March
breaking_news.summary: U.S. equity funds saw about $22.33B of net outflows in the week to Aug. 26 while bond funds drew $7.12B, showing more cautious positioning around Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole.
breaking_news.market_impact: Confirms that index resilience masks defensive fund-flow behavior.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Raises the bar for Taiwan AI beta to sustain gains without fresh U.S. inflows.

breaking_news.headline: Next week shifts from Nvidia to U.S. jobs and AI-infrastructure earnings
breaking_news.summary: Markets will focus on JOLTS, ADP, ISM surveys and Friday payrolls while Broadcom, Dell, Palo Alto Networks and Snowflake report.
breaking_news.market_impact: Jobs data will drive September Fed-hike pricing; AI hardware/software earnings will test whether demand breadth extends beyond Nvidia.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Broadcom/Dell results are directly relevant to ASIC, networking, AI server, PCB, cooling and power-supply chains.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Post-earnings reversal leaves AI fundamentals strong but rate sensitivity exposed
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Nvidia closed Friday at $217.55, down 4.57%, one day after its earnings-driven surge; the 52-week position remains about 73.8%.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Strong earnings alone did not prevent profit-taking as yields rose.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: TSMC/AI-server suppliers need local rotation confirmation rather than relying only on Nvidia's earnings beat.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Next week's AI demand test broadens beyond GPUs
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Broadcom and Dell are among the major reports next week, alongside Palo Alto Networks and Snowflake.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Will test AI networking, custom silicon, server and enterprise-software monetization.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Broadcom/Dell are especially relevant for Taiwanese ASIC, network, ODM, PCB, cooling and power suppliers.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Megacap software/device leadership diverged from chips on Friday
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple rose 1.63% and Microsoft 1.68% while Nvidia, AMD and TSM ADR fell.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Leadership rotation away from semiconductors helped contain index losses.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Consumer-device and enterprise-AI exposure may provide selective offsets to semiconductor weakness.

major_earnings.headline: Q2 revenue $96.22B, adjusted EPS $2.22; Q3 guide $108B +/-2%
major_earnings.guidance: Strong AI demand but margin/supply questions remain a valuation sensitivity.

major_earnings.guidance: Q3 revenue about $3.15B; long-term AI/custom-silicon outlook raised but near-term timing questioned.

major_earnings.headline: Fiscal Q3 report is a key AI networking/custom silicon read-through
major_earnings.guidance: Consensus referenced by Kiplinger: EPS about $3.24, revenue about $29.4B.

narration_points: 週末美股沒有新交易，最新完整交易日仍是8月28日：標普跌0.25%、那斯達克跌0.52%、Russell 2000跌1.39%，道瓊近乎持平。
Warsh偏鷹訊號仍主導跨資產：10年期美債約4.72%，美元指數約99.68；黃金12月期貨跌2.88%，WTI收83.40美元。
半導體仍是最弱主線：SOX約跌3.47%，NVIDIA收217.55美元跌4.57%，TSM ADR跌2.29%，AMD跌2.33%；Apple與Microsoft則逆勢上漲。
台指期最新可用夜盤仍是8月28日15點到8月29日5點的週五夜盤，收45,900點，較日盤參考價跌457點；週末沒有更新交易，不得拿其他日期夜盤替換。
過去24小時新增的風險是美國財政部對日圓失序波動的警告，以及美股基金大額流出；下週市場焦點轉向JOLTS、ADP、ISM與8月非農。
企業端下一個AI驗證點是Broadcom與Dell：若AI網通、自研ASIC與伺服器需求持續超預期，台股ASIC、網通、ODM、PCB、散熱與電源才有機會重新取得主導權。
